title: Dig Through Earth

script.text: Dig straight down from America, and you won't reach China.

script: Now drill through the center of the Earth.

script.text: That's a tunnel about [12,700|twelve thousand seven hundred] kilometers long.
You come out here. The southern Indian Ocean.

script: Flip all [48|forty-eight] lower states to the other side of the planet.
Almost all of it lands in the ocean.

script.text: The only land underneath? A few tiny French islands.

script: China's real opposite is South America.
Hong Kong sits almost exactly opposite La Quiaca, a small town in Argentina.
Spain's other side is New Zealand.

script.text: And Bermuda's is Perth, in Australia.
In fact, only about [15%|fifteen percent] of the world's land has land on the other side.
The rest comes out in the ocean.
